facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.name: forward
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/proje.description: Args:

ref_entities: build a Scaler to convert continuous scale values to discrete integer indices using log quantization
build a Scaler to convert discrete integer indices back to continuous scale values
create a ContinuousIndexedGaussianConditional entropy model with indexed mean and scale parameters for neural compression
build a GsnConditionalLocScaleShift module to compress input tensors into byte strings using indexed Gaussian priors
build a GsnConditionalLocScaleShift module to decompress byte strings back into quantized tensors
build a VCTEntropyModel with custom num_channels, context_len, and d_model hyperparameters for video compression
run the VCTEntropyModel forward pass with an unquantized latent and previous latents to get perturbed output and bits
run the VCTEntropyModel compress method to autoregressively encode a latent into compressed strings and count bits
run process_previous_latent_q to pre-process a quantized latent through the encoder for efficient context conditioning
run the VCTEntropyModel update method to refresh entropy bottleneck CDF values after training for compression
build a LearnedPosition module that adds learned positional encodings to a 3D tensor input
build a StartSym module that prefixes a sequence tensor with a learned start symbol
build a TransformerBlock with self-attention and cross-attention for encoder or decoder use
build a Transformer stack of configurable transformer blocks for encoding or decoding sequences
build an EncoderSection transformer encoder with no look-ahead masking for sequence encoding
build a python module to create an MLP head for transformer blocks with GELU activation and dropout
build a python module to compute windowed multi-head self-attention with optional masking on query key and value tensors
build a python module to create a stochastic depth layer that randomly drops entire samples during training
create a function that builds a Conv2d layer with automatic padding from in_channels out_channels and kernel_size
create a function that builds a linear embedding layer with uniform weight initialization scaled by input dimension
build a Patcher module with a given stride and padding mode for tensor patching
create a Patched named tuple holding a patched tensor and its patch count
test the forward method to extract non-overlapping or overlapping patches from a 4D tensor
test the unpatch method to reconstruct a 4D tensor from patched patches
review the _pad method that pads tensors for valid patch extraction with reflect mode
build a ConvGDNAnalysis module to encode video frames into compressed latent embeddings using GDN transforms
build a ConvGDNSynthesis module to decode compressed latent embeddings back into reconstructed video frames
build an ELICAnalysis module to encode video frames using residual units and attention blocks for compression
build an ELICSynthesis module to decode ELIC-compressed latents back into reconstructed video frames
review the ResidualUnit class implementing a simple residual block with bottleneck convolutions and ReLU activation
